sn28.1:1.1: Sāriputta was the greatest disciple of the Buddha, foremost in wisdom ([an1.189]()), the “general of the Dhamma” ([ud2.8:16.2]()) who was “like unto the Teacher himself” ([mn24:17.5]()). He is equally known for his magnificent expostions of fundamental teachings ([mn141](), his ready conversation on profound matters ([mn43]()
